seal.statement: Phase 0.3 locking reads use one deterministic fail-fast reservation-conflict policy with machine/prose semantic agreement: participant owns acquire/conflict and emits typed contention; DistributedTransactionCoordinator owns the follow-on whole-transaction conflict abort, confirms rollback/release of earlier reservations before terminal transaction_aborted, owns timeout/cancellation/commit/rollback/recovery, no waiter queue or local TTL exists, and the architecture document and machine-readable policy encode the same owner/action/outcome table.
